hero.heading: Try Program Partner free for 30 days.
hero.subhead: No card, and no sales call unless you want one. Tell us about your program and we'll reply within one business day to set it up with you.

how.heading: How the trial works
items: We reply within one business day and set up your program with you, the same guided setup every program gets.
Try every feature for 30 days with your own program: rosters, fees, forms, events, inventory, the music library and the teaching tools.
There's no card to enter, so nothing is charged when the 30 days end.
Subscribe whenever you're ready, and everything you added stays.
how.founding_note: Programs that subscribe by June 30, 2027 keep the $299 founding price every year they renew.
